notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hi, I just made a small patch to address a couple of issues.[/p][list][*][p]Selected language now saves properly so you don't need to keep selecting it every time you start the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Wave of Mutilation" achievement is fixed, so it should pop when you kill a boss with the Wave gun.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks![/p][p]Graeme[/p]

tags.bug: Selected language now saves properly so you don't need to keep selecting it every time you start the game.
The "Wave of Mutilation" achievement is fixed, so it should pop when you kill a boss with the Wave gun.

notes.title: ZOE Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the new ZOE demo is now available to download!

[previewyoutube=JC87j51CDlg;full][/previewyoutube]

Updates from previous versions include -

- New power ups!
- Power up shop
- Dash and Pound charge mechanics
- Apples!
- Bananas!
- New music!
- Loads of game feel things and bug fixes!

We really hope you enjoy the demo and please keep an eye out for updates as we progress towards the full release.

Cheers!
Graeme

tags.bug: - Loads of game feel things and bug fixes!
